society_traits.explanation: An archive role or recorded archive accord makes records a practical source of institutional standing.
Recorded institutional heirs govern through inherited offices rather than claiming an entirely new founding.
An assigned border-watch role or a directly witnessed border dispute makes guarding boundaries a daily concern.
An isolation role or a recorded regional access restriction supports constrained connections, without claiming every road is physically closed.
Actual recorded underground closure makes deep access management salient without inventing Innerworld ancestry.
The real regional pressure remains part of practical safety memory. This is a memory custom, not a new faction-specific catastrophe.
A clan livelihood organizes household autonomy. A regional response alone cannot assign this to unrelated factions.
Authority is exercised over an actual local settlement belonging to this current polity. This does not assert elections or universal consent.
The recorded maintenance role or facility/guild livelihood organizes daily service responsibilities.
Actual local plurality of authored lineage templates or a multi-Origin lineage supports bodily/lineage coexistence; a lifestyle name is insufficient.
Direct positive relationship events or a communal livelihood support obligations between members or communities.
An actual newcomer formation or population join makes incorporation of arriving residents part of social life; no written charter is asserted.
Daily customs can change to meet concrete survival needs; this structural habit is distinct from the normative doctrine Practical Heresy.
Actual merger or multiple political parents supports consolidated institutions, not biological fusion.
An actual faith community, religious livelihood, or recorded sacred-site reuse supports communal stewardship of belief and religious practice.
Office rotation requires an explicitly authored rotation institution; political reorganization alone does not prove rotating tenure.
An assigned exchange role, trading livelihood or direct reopening accord organizes shared access and exchange.
An actual recorded scavenging reuse supports salvage practice; technical competence alone is insufficient.
Recorded regional orbital damage or debris becomes shared hazard memory; it is not proof of Outerworld contact or purposeful targeting.
An actual shelter role or refugee-community livelihood organizes refuge and local accommodation.

doctrines.explanation: Preserving inherited human form is important; generic kinship or a single baseline template cannot establish a genetic-preservation norm.

goal_candidates.explanation: Consider preserve lineage as a future social priority; no target, capability or completed action is asserted.

doctrines.explanation: A rebuilding community in an actual collapsed region may prioritize beauty in public reconstruction rather than utility alone.

goal_candidates.explanation: Consider beautiful public works as a future social priority; no target, capability or completed action is asserted.

doctrines.explanation: Actual regional orbital damage, debris or failed surveillance motivates restraint on reaching or signaling upward. The source motive and any Outerworld connection remain unknown.

A future access-policy candidate.

doctrines.explanation: Recorded underground closure supports a norm of keeping dangerous deep access closed, without implying Innerworld contact.
